page_id.description: Snapshot identifier returned to this client by web_open. Unknown or expired IDs return page_unavailable. Then call web_open with the url again.

pattern.description: Literal text to find. Accepts 1–1024 Unicode characters. Regular expressions and wildcards are not evaluated.

case_sensitive.description: Case matching mode. Accepts false or true, default false. false uses Unicode case-insensitive matching, true requires the exact case.

start_line.description: First line to search, 1-based. Accepts 1–10000, default 1. To continue a truncated result, pass the previous next_start_line.

max_matches.description: Maximum matching lines. Accepts 1–100, default 20. Fewer may return to fit the response budget. Then truncated and next_start_line report the rest.
